title: Want to lighten your mental load? First, let go of these gender myths
summary: "Men can't see the mess." "Women are better at chores." These myths position women to take on more emotional thinking, says researcher Leah Ruppanner. She shares what works to reclaim your headspace.
contentText:
Drained: Reduce Your Mental Load to Do Less and Be More , busts pervasive cultural myths that keep a woman's mental load heavy.'/> "Men can't see the mess." "Women are better at chores." These myths position women to take on more emotional thinking, says researcher Leah Ruppanner. She shares what works to reclaim your headspace.
